module: LuaJIT's jit.zone module (Mike Pall, MIT license, 2005-2026): hierarchical stack of named "zones" used by the profiler (jit.p with the z option) to group samples by logical zone. The module is a callable object: zone('name') pushes a zone, zone() with no argument pops one (error "empty zone stack" if empty).
usage:
local zone = require('jit.zone')
zone('IA')
  zone('A*')
  print(zone:get()) --> 'A*'
  zone()
print(zone:get()) --> 'IA'
zone()
notes: The call zone() returns the popped zone.
The profiler detects the current zone via the stack: every pushed zone must be popped, otherwise the following zones are skewed.

get.desc: Returns the name of the current zone (top of the stack), nil if the stack is empty.
